Attach a Validated Apptainer or rcapsule Container to a SLURM Job Spec

Source: R/container_hook.R
use_rcapsule_container.Rd

Provides a zero-hard-dependency handoff between reproducible container builders (such as rcapsule manifests/specs, build_apptainer_def() recipes, or pre-built .sif / .def file paths) and slurm_job_spec(). Strictly validates all container paths and --bind mounts against traversal and shell/option injection, records provenance metadata (digest, r_version, def_path, source), and injects SLURMPILOT_CONTAINER_DIGEST into the job environment when a cryptographic digest is supplied.

Usage

use_rcapsule_container(
  spec = NULL,
  container,
  binds = character(),
  check_exists = FALSE
)

Arguments

spec

Optional slurmpilot_job_spec object to update. When NULL, returns a standalone validated "slurmpilot_container_spec" object.

container

Container descriptor: either (a) a character path to an Apptainer .sif image or .def recipe, (b) a slurmpilot_apptainer_def object from build_apptainer_def(), or (c) a duck-typed rcapsule spec or manifest list containing fields such as apptainer_sif / sif_path / image, apptainer_def / def_path / recipe_path, content_digest / capsule_hash / env_hash, r_version, binds, or nested targets$apptainer / manifest.

binds

Optional character vector of extra Apptainer --bind mounts (e.g. "/data:/data:ro").

check_exists

Logical; if TRUE, asserts that any resolved local .sif or .def path exists on disk. Default FALSE (cluster paths often exist only on the remote HPC filesystem).

Value

Updated slurmpilot_job_spec (when spec is supplied) or a "slurmpilot_container_spec" object (when spec is NULL).

See also

slurm_job_spec(), build_apptainer_def(), render_sbatch_script()

Examples

spec <- slurm_job_spec(
  fun = function(x) x + 1,
  args_list = list(1, 2),
  resources = resource_spec(2L)
)
capsule <- list(
  sif_path = "/scratch/containers/analysis.sif",
  def_path = "/scratch/containers/analysis.def",
  content_digest = "a1b2c3d4e5f6",
  r_version = "4.4.1",
  binds = c("/scratch/data:/data:ro")
)
spec2 <- use_rcapsule_container(spec, capsule)
spec2$container_sif
#> [1] "/scratch/containers/analysis.sif"
